newsitem.title: USA: Astec reports preliminary count on tender.
newsitem.headline: Astec reports preliminary count on tender.

text.p: Astec Industries Inc said on Friday that a preliminary count found about 726,369 shares of common stock had been tendered and accepted for purchase at a price of $10.50 per share in its "Dutch Auction" self-tender offer.

The count was conducted by ChaseMellon Shareholder Services L.L.C., the depository for the company's self-tender offer, which began on March 27 and expired at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on May 1, the company said in a statement.
The company said in March that the offer was for up to two million shares of the company's common stock.
Prior to the tender offer, Astec had 10,044,199 shares of common stock outstanding, the company said. After the share purchase, Astec will have about 9,317,830, it added.
Astec Industries Inc designs and manufactures equipment and components used in road building and related construction.
